title: SealedRecord
description: Written once by the Seal, never updated. This is what /r/<id> renders and what a stranger checks.

schema_version.description: 1. Absent reads as 1. Sealed evidence is upgraded on read, never migrated in place — see specs/2026-08-20-firestore-design.md section 9.1.

id.description: Opaque and unguessable. It is a public URL.

public.description: A public projection exists at /records/{public_id}. Sharing is a deliberate act by any tenant, not a property of demo tenants.

ceiling_unreachable.description: Each with the one-line reason it is out of reach at this tier. This is the call to action, and it is honest.

deficiencies.description: What the Gate reads. A deficiency against a field required at this strictness holds the machine.

machine_released.description: The Gate's answer. Deterministic, from deficiencies and strictness.

public_id.description: The capability URL id: 22 chars of crypto randomness, NOT derived from the job id, which would be enumerable. Null until shared; unsharing deletes the public document and every media URL dies with it.

issuer.description: Who stands behind this record, denormalised at seal time.

actors.description: The people, as they were AT SEAL TIME. Denormalised deliberately: a record is immutable, so it must not change when someone updates their profile photo or leaves the company. Bare uids render as nothing to a stranger.
